name: Flashcards
description: Make your own decks and study them with spaced repetition: the cards you find hard come back sooner.
prompt: A flashcards app: create decks by writing one card per line as question = answer, flip cards to study, rate each one as again, hard, good or easy, and schedule reviews with spaced repetition. Show how many cards are due in each deck.
author: gonzaroman
